verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents broad API coverage for sending, receiving, tracking, and webhooks. It also has a Postman collection of 'all Mailgun APIs' and an official MCP server that can manage domains and stats, so much of the product is programmable. However, no source claims UI-to-API parity, and some FAQ guidance directs users to the Control Panel (e.g., enabling spam filtering), so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API equivalents for Control Panel-only actions such as spam filtering and account/SSO settings, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent corroboration.
